dispute_ticket.description: I tapped cancel less than three minutes after the driver was assigned, but the app froze for a bit and I was still charged $4.00. The window is three minutes so I should not pay.

app_events.details: Rider R-7104 booked trip RYDE-DS-004 from Bishan MRT to Orchard Ion.
Driver D-8104 (Mohd Faizal, Hyundai Ioniq SMD 6150 E) assigned. Match time 09:20:00.
Rider tapped 'Cancel trip' on device (device clock 09:22:40). Request queued: no network response.
Cancel request reached server after network retry; server time 09:23:25.
Cancellation fee S$4.00 applied based on server receipt time (3 min 25 s after match).

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

cancellation_time_basis.text: States which timestamp decides whether a cancellation falls inside the free window: the moment the rider taps cancel on the device, or the moment the server receives it.

cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned.text: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after a driver has been assigned and outside any free window. It governs rider cancellations only.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver was matched at 09:20:00 and the rider tapped cancel at 09:22:40 on the device, 2 min 40 s later, inside the 3-minute free window. The fee was applied only because the request reached the server at 09:23:25 after a network retry. This trip's policy says the device tap time decides the window, so no fee was due and the S$4.00 should be refunded in full.
